intro.zh: 这里列出我们评测用的全部题目：自编的、从公开数据集改编的，以及原样使用的公开题。每道题都标了来源与人审状态，可以展开看完整的输入、答案与判分标准。留出集的题只给题量，不公开内容，否则它就不再是“没见过的题”。
intro.en: Every question we evaluate with: written in-house, adapted from public datasets, or used as-is. Each one shows its source and review status, and expands to the full input, answer and scoring rule. Held-out questions are counted but not shown, so that they stay unseen.

title.zh: Task Loop 评测框架（自研）

what.zh: 把一道题交给被测对象（规则基线、标准答案或真正的 Planner 与 Reviewer），按规则判分：分诊对不对、规划的形状是否合格、Reviewer 的判定是否在可接受的范围里；留出集只给汇总。
what.en: Gives each case to a subject (a rule baseline, the reference answer, or the real Planner and Reviewer) and scores it by rule: correct triage, an acceptable plan shape, a verdict within the accepted set. Held-out results are reported only in aggregate.

why.zh: 没有现成的框架能评我们自己的分诊、Planner 与 Reviewer 的决策：它们的输入输出是本系统特有的格式。
why.en: No existing framework scores our own triage, Planner and Reviewer decisions: their inputs and outputs are specific to this system.

what.zh: 把一个角色钉在一个模型上，跑组件级与公开数据集的题，用 bootstrap 与收缩估出每个模型在每个角色上的分数与区间，人看过才发布进 Model Profile。
what.en: Pins one role to one model, runs component and public-dataset cells, estimates each model's score and interval per role with bootstrap and shrinkage, and publishes into Model Profiles only after human review.

why.zh: 路由要知道每个模型在每种工作上有多好；公开榜单的分数不按我们的角色划分，也不是在我们的系统里测的。
why.en: Routing needs to know how good each model is at each kind of work; public leaderboards are neither split by our roles nor measured inside our system.

what.zh: 交付质量：正确性（与参考答案比，G-Eval）、切题（AnswerRelevancy）、诚实（G-Eval）。裁判经 Model Gateway 调用，钉在 Opus 5.5，逐条留记录；与被测模型同一家时标出。
what.en: Deliverable quality: correctness against the reference (G-Eval), relevancy (AnswerRelevancy) and honesty (G-Eval). The judge goes through the Model Gateway pinned to Opus 5.5, every judgment logged, and same-vendor pairs flagged.

why.zh: 用官方实现，不自己写判分；改的只有裁判的调用方式（经网关，花费与模型都有记录）。
why.en: The official metrics, not our own; only the judge call is changed (through the gateway, so cost and model are recorded).

what.zh: 记忆检索：自己算命中率、召回率与 MRR（不要模型），Ragas 算上下文的精确率与召回率；给了裁判时另算要模型的两项。
what.en: Memory retrieval: hit rate, recall and MRR computed without a model, Ragas context precision and recall, and two model-judged metrics when a judge is configured.

why.zh: 检索质量有成熟的指标，照用；数据换成公开的 LongMemEval 之后，这一套继续用来打分。
why.en: Retrieval has established metrics, used as they are; they keep scoring once the data moves to the public LongMemEval.

title.zh: SWE-bench 官方判分工具（标准框架）

what.zh: 在题目的官方 Docker 环境里跑隐藏的测试，判这道题修好了没有。
what.en: Runs the hidden tests in each problem's official Docker environment to decide whether it is resolved.

why.zh: 原样用：分数与公开榜单同一口径。
why.en: Used as-is, so scores are comparable with public leaderboards.

title.zh: Terminal-Bench 离线判分（改编）与 Harbor（标准）

what.zh: 改编的一条：经 Task API 跑我们的系统，只把工作目录带回来，在官方镜像里换上改动后跑测试。Harbor 一条：在任务原来的容器里跑并判分。
what.en: Adapted path: runs our system through the Task API, brings back only the working directory, and runs the tests in the official image with those changes. Harbor path: runs and grades inside the task's own container.

why.zh: Task API 不能在任务的容器里跑验收命令，所以改编；代价是靠工作目录以外状态的题判不出来，分数偏保守。两条都留着对照。
why.en: The Task API cannot run a check command inside the task container, hence the adaptation; tasks that depend on state outside the working directory cannot be graded this way, so scores lean conservative. Both paths are kept for comparison.

title.zh: 公开数据集的官方模板（个别改编）
title.en: Official templates of public datasets (a few adapted)

what.zh: BFCL 移植了官方的 AST 规则，τ²-bench 用官方环境与判分，RewardBench 2、JudgeBench、LongBench v2、SimpleQA、FRAMES 用官方提示。
what.en: BFCL with a port of the official AST checker, τ²-bench with its official environments and grading, and the official prompts for RewardBench 2, JudgeBench, LongBench v2, SimpleQA and FRAMES.

why.zh: 改了两处，都写明了：BFCL 经网关时参数都是浮点数，按函数声明把整数还原，且只做单轮；SimpleQA 老实答“不知道”给 0.25 分（官方给 0），报告里同时给官方口径。
why.en: Two documented changes: BFCL restores integers from the gateway's float arguments by the function signature and covers single turn only; SimpleQA gives 0.25 for an honest “don't know” (official: 0), with the official numbers reported alongside.

description.zh: 一条消息进来，系统怎么分诊、第一步怎么规划；后面每个 Round 结束时 Reviewer 该怎么判。
description.en: How an incoming message should be triaged and planned, and how the Reviewer should judge the end of each round.

description.zh: 一个 Round 的结果摆在面前，Reviewer 该判完成、继续、修、重规划、回滚、换路、问人还是放弃。
description.en: Given one round's results: done, continue, repair, replan, rollback, reroute, escalate or abort.

description.zh: 长任务压缩上下文之后，关键的事实还在不在、做过的事会不会重做。
description.en: After a long task's context is compacted, are the key facts still there, and is finished work redone?

description.zh: 同一个会话里的追问：能从之前的回复里答的直接答，要读仓库的才去规划。
description.en: Follow-ups in one session: answer from earlier replies when possible, plan only when the repository must be read.

description.zh: 对着一个小仓库提问或改代码，看回答对不对、切不切题、诚不诚实。
description.en: Questions and edits against a small repository: is the answer correct, relevant and honest?

description.zh: 16 条记忆、10 个问题：检索能不能找到答案所在的那几条。以后换成公开的 LongMemEval。
description.en: 16 memories, 10 questions: does retrieval find the ones holding the answer? To be replaced by the public LongMemEval.

description.zh: Google DeepMind 的行程、会面与日程规划题，原题原样，套上我们的分诊与规划标注；另有派生的追问与返工题。
description.en: Google DeepMind's trip, meeting and calendar planning problems, verbatim, with our triage and planning labels; plus derived follow-up and replan cases.

description.zh: OSU 的旅行规划题，带题目给定的历史参考信息，套上我们的分诊与规划标注。
description.en: OSU's travel planning problems with their given reference information, labelled with our triage and planning.

description.zh: 真实的 GitHub issue，考的是怎么分诊与规划修复；修复补丁与测试不给模型。
description.en: Real GitHub issues, testing how a fix is triaged and planned; the gold patch and tests are withheld from the model.

description.zh: 给出原题的实现补丁与测试补丁，问它改了什么、测了什么。
description.en: Given a problem's implementation and test patches: what changed and what is tested?

source.license: 数据集卡未声明；各仓库的补丁按其许可证（多为 BSD、Apache-2.0、MIT）
source.selection: t18-rev19 与 sol-rev18 用的 50 题：seed 0，按仓库与难度分层，不含 psf/requests

description.zh: 真实 GitHub 仓库的 issue：读懂问题、改代码，官方测试判是否修好。答案是官方的修复补丁与测试。
description.en: Real GitHub issues: understand the problem and change the code; official tests decide whether it is fixed. The answer is the official fix and its tests.

source.selection: 全部 89 题；portable 为 false 的离线判分做不了，只能经 Harbor

description.zh: 在终端里完成真实任务（编译、配置、数据处理……），由隐藏测试判分。官方参考解不放在这里（避免题目流进训练数据）。
description.en: Real tasks in a terminal (build, configure, process data…), graded by hidden tests. Official reference solutions are not shown here, to keep them out of training data.

source.selection: 能力矩阵第一轮每格的前缀：n = 40、seed = 0（各适配器的哈希排序，n 变大只在后面追加）

description.zh: 给出函数声明，看模型调不调对函数、参数对不对（单轮）。
description.en: Given function declarations: does the model call the right function with the right arguments (single turn)?

source.license: MIT（题目来自 MMLU-Pro、LiveBench、LiveCodeBench，各有许可；回答不要拿来训练）
source.selection: 能力矩阵第一轮每格的前缀：n = 40、seed = 0（各适配器的哈希排序，n 变大只在后面追加）

description.zh: 两份回答哪份对：难题上的裁判能力，两种顺序各判一次。
description.en: Which of two responses is right: judging on hard questions, in both orders.

source.selection: 能力矩阵第一轮每格的前缀：n = 40、seed = 0（各适配器的哈希排序，n 变大只在后面追加）

description.zh: 读很长的材料再做选择题。这里只给问题与选项，长篇原文不展示（太长，许可各异）。
description.en: Multiple choice over very long material. Only the question and options are shown; the long context is not (too long, mixed licences).

source.selection: 能力矩阵第一轮每格的前缀：n = 40、seed = 0（各适配器的哈希排序，n 变大只在后面追加）

description.zh: 简短的事实题：答对、答错还是老实说不知道。
description.en: Short factual questions: right, wrong, or an honest “don't know”.

source.selection: 能力矩阵第一轮每格的前缀：n = 40、seed = 0（各适配器的哈希排序，n 变大只在后面追加）

description.zh: 要查好几篇资料、再推理的多跳问题。
description.en: Multi-hop questions that need several sources and some reasoning.
